text: The radical invents the views. When he has worn them out the conservative adopts them.
author: Mark Twain
visual_brief: Precise engineering drawing in orthographic views showing an escapement and ratchet gear assembly. Fine white lines detail the leading impulse pallet pushing an angular tooth forward while a trailing locking pallet drops into the notch behind it, complete with circular motion arrows and tension vectors.
alt: Engineering schematic of a mechanical ratchet and pawl gear system
